title: Financial confidence is about more than managing money – it is about having the confidence to take action
summary: Seema Sachdev, Head of Customer Lifecycle Management, Barclays, writes that while consumers are keeping a closer watch on their finances than ever before, turning confidence into action remains one of the UK's biggest financial challenges.
body_markdown: As Barclays launches our new Financial Confidence Index, Vim Maru, Chief Executive Officer of Barclays UK, highlights how households have rebuilt resilience, but warns confidence is not yet translating into action.
